title: Derived category
html: Derived category. For an abelian category \mathbf{A}, the derived category D(\mathbf{A}) is the localisation of the category of cochain complexes in \mathbf{A} at the quasi-isomorphisms (the maps inducing isomorphisms on cohomology); equivalently, the localisation of the homotopy category of complexes at the same class. It is a triangulated category whose distinguished triangles come from short exact sequences of complexes. The bounded derived category D^{b}(\mathbf{A}) is the full subcategory of complexes with bounded cohomology, and D^{b}(X) for a variety X means D^{b} of coherent sheaves on X.
